query:
SELECT i.id AS "id!: i64", i.series_id AS "series_id!: i64",
                  i.cv_issue_id, i.metron_issue_id, i.number, i.title, i.cover_date,
                  i.summary, i.cover_url, i.store_date,
                  i.created_at AS "created_at: _", i.updated_at AS "updated_at: _"
           FROM issues i
           WHERE i.series_id = ?
             AND length(COALESCE(i.store_date, i.cover_date)) = 10
             AND COALESCE(i.store_date, i.cover_date) <= date('now')
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM files f
               WHERE f.issue_id = i.id
                 AND f.status = 'owned'
                 AND f.is_present = 1
             )
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM pull_attempts pa
               WHERE pa.issue_id = i.id
                 AND (
                   pa.status IN ('pending', 'grabbed')
                   OR (pa.status = 'submitted'
                       AND pa.attempted_at >= datetime('now', '-6 hours'))
                 )
             )
             -- Parked: backoff by highest retry_count (3: 7d, 4: 14d,
             -- 5+: 30d) from the newest attempt. Same rule as
             -- pull_attempt_repo::attempt_blockers.
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM (
                 SELECT MAX(pa.retry_count) AS rc, MAX(pa.attempted_at) AS last
                 FROM pull_attempts pa WHERE pa.issue_id = i.id
               ) p
               WHERE p.rc >= 3
                 AND p.last > datetime('now', CASE p.rc WHEN 3 THEN '-7 days'
                                                       WHEN 4 THEN '-14 days'
                                                       ELSE '-30 days' END)
             )
           ORDER BY COALESCE(i.store_date, i.cover_date) ASC, i.id ASC
